reply.text: This is one for your surgeon or physio, not a coach, especially with an ACL reconstruction. Plyometrics are a return-to-sport decision that depends on your knee's strength tests and what your clinician has cleared, and I won't guess at it from here. Once they give you the go-ahead and tell me what's allowed, I'll build the rest of your training around it. Ask them specifically which jumping and landing drills are cleared and at what stage, and bring me that list.
